newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pique says salary moderation needed.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pique says salary moderation needed.

text.p: Spain's Industry Ministry Josep Pique said on Tuesday salary moderation was a must, but that no decision had yet been taken to put into effect a prior accord for salary moderation at metals groups at state holding group AIE.

"Salary moderation is a requirement overall in the country because it is a guarantee that real salaries grow and therefore, the workers' purchasing power grows. The moderation in salaries will help reduce interest rates and, at the same time, favour economic growth," Pique told journalists on the fringes of a seminar.
AIE is a state holding that groups loss-making state enterprises as well as the profitable metals group Confederacion Siderurgia Integral, which is due for privatisation this year.

"There is a general agreement in the area of metal companies in the Agencia Industrial del Estado (AIE) that foresees salary moderation for a period of three years. What is now being analysed is the impact of this moderation in 1997 and until the analysis is complete we will not institute it," he said.
